metadata.title: Oracle Stock Is Rising. Why It’s So Much More Than a Bet on OpenAI.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Oracle Stock Is Rising. Why It’s So Much More Than a Bet on OpenAI.
There are worse things to be than OpenAI’s main cloud-computing supplier, in a world where the artificial-intelligence investing boom doesn’t look likely to slow down anytime soon.
